cite: 91 Fed. Reg. 72841 (12 Nov 2026), proposed rule, SA Coral Amendment 11 / Shrimp Amendment 12
title: Proposed: shrimp fishery access area beside the Oculina Bank HAPC (not a spearfishing rule; comments to 14 Dec 2026)
effect: Proposed only. Would add § 622.224(b)(3) and a table for a rock shrimp access area by the Oculina Bank HAPC. It does not change any recreational or spearfishing rule and does not correct the HAPC coordinate defects in § 622.224 (open question 18).
excerpt: DATES: Written comments on the proposed rule must be received on or before December 14, 2026.
scope: South Atlantic EEZ off east-central Florida.
